ops.oldText: unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
ops.newText: unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice before the end of the then-current term. Vendor will notify Customer of the upcoming renewal at least sixty days before the end of the then-current term.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window from 180 days to 30 days and added a 60-day renewal reminder, consistent with our playbook position that renewals must be easy to exit; a window of up to 60 days would also work for us. The 12-month renewal term and the CPI/3% uplift cap in § 8.3 are acceptable as drafted.
input.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice from 180 to 30 days and add Vendor renewal reminder 60 days before renewal.
